propositions: Interrupted retirement operations leave one exact identity both live and tombstoned; recovery must classify and complete these states without guessing across mismatched identities.

Create recovery logic must be extracted into binding_recovery.py without changing existing labels, immutable known-key behavior, grace periods, failure tally, or continue semantics; the facade signature and existing call sites remain untouched.

Retirement completion classifies only when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry agree on exact local_id and Jira key; completion removes redundant live pairs while retaining the tombstone.

Any identity mismatch, corrupt live file, or replacement failure must safety-abort with typed response and retain evidence for manual intervention; completion is idempotent and performsno write on repeat.
Keyless pending recovery must still enforce both three-miss threshold and 3600-second grace; one entry failure does not stop others.
Pre-existing create-recovery invocation gate remains unscoped-passes-only with no write-bearing or persist gate, and retirement completion is not automatically invoked.
